rungs.title: Head of Department
rungs.summary: Runs a whole function and sits on the leadership team.
rungs.knowledge: Expert in their function and literate in the others.
rungs.delivery: Owns a function's results and budget.
rungs.leadership: Leads managers and works as one team with the other heads.

rungs.title: General Manager
rungs.summary: Runs a business unit end to end.
rungs.knowledge: Reads the unit's finance, customers, people and risk together.
rungs.delivery: Owns a business unit's profit, growth and customer outcomes.
rungs.leadership: Leads several heads of department and answers to the CEO.

rungs.title: Chief Operating Officer
rungs.summary: Runs the day-to-day of the whole company.
rungs.knowledge: Sees every function, its costs and where the company will break under growth.
rungs.delivery: Owns operations, planning and the company's performance against its plan.
rungs.leadership: Leads the executive team's operating rhythm and is the CEO's deputy.

rungs.title: CEO
rungs.summary: Sets the direction of the company and answers for it.
rungs.knowledge: Understands the market, the money, the technology and the people, and how AI is changing all four.
rungs.delivery: Sets strategy, allocates capital and is accountable for the company's results.
rungs.leadership: Leads the leadership team, the culture and the company's relationship with investors, customers and regulators.
